decisions.reason: This compact rotating-skip dumper extends the firm's core construction range, still has its own page, and costs little to keep while demand develops.
The articulated dumper builds on established competencies and remains prominently presented, so the option stays open at low holding cost.
Its downgrade from its own page to a mention signals weakening prospects in a niche far from the core, but a rescue vehicle costs little to keep listed and its value is not yet clearly disproven.
The compact telescopic loader fits the firm's established offer, keeps its own page, and its uncertainty has not resolved against it.
The material lift is a long-popular rental product with a recent large order, so it is a proven option worth continued commitment.
Quantified field results of 1,000 operating hours in seven months show its value is being realized, which justifies further investment.
